description: This file defines the ServiceQuotasClient class used to interact with AWS Service Quotas, including method signatures for various quota management operations.

classes.name: ServiceQuotasClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Service Quotas API interactions, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: associateServiceQuotaTemplate
methods.description: Associates a service quota template.

methods.name: associateServiceQuotaTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a service quota template.

methods.name: deleteServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestFromTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a service quota increase request from a template.

methods.name: deleteServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestFromTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a service quota increase request from a template.

methods.name: disassociateServiceQuotaTemplate
methods.description: Disassociates a service quota template.

methods.name: disassociateServiceQuotaTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a service quota template.

methods.name: getAWSDefaultServiceQuota
methods.description: Retrieves the default service quota for AWS.

methods.name: getAWSDefaultServiceQuotaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the default AWS service quota.

methods.name: getAssociationForServiceQuotaTemplate
methods.description: Gets the association for a service quota template.

methods.name: getAssociationForServiceQuotaTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the association for a service quota template.

methods.name: getRequestedServiceQuotaChange
methods.description: Retrieves a requested service quota change.

methods.name: getRequestedServiceQuotaChangeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a requested service quota change.

methods.name: getServiceQuota
methods.description: Gets information about a specific service quota.

methods.name: getServiceQuotaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets information about a specific service quota.

methods.name: getServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestFromTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a service quota increase request from a template.

methods.name: getServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestFromTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a service quota increase request from a template.

methods.name: listAWSDefaultServiceQuotas
methods.description: Lists AWS default service quotas.

methods.name: listAWSDefaultServiceQuotasAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists AWS default service quotas.

methods.name: listRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistory
methods.description: Lists the history of requested service quota changes.

methods.name: listRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists the history of requested service quota changes.

methods.name: listRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistoryByQuota
methods.description: Lists change history by quota.

methods.name: listRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistoryByQuotaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists change history by quota.

methods.name: listServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestsInTemplate
methods.description: Lists service quota increase requests in a template.

methods.name: listServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestsInTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists service quota increase requests in a template.

methods.name: listServiceQuotas
methods.description: Lists service quotas.

methods.name: listServiceQuotasAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists service quotas.

methods.name: listServices
methods.description: Lists available services.

methods.name: listServicesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists available services.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: putServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestIntoTemplate
methods.description: Puts a service quota increase request into a template.

methods.name: putServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestIntoTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously puts a service quota increase request into a template.

methods.name: requestServiceQuotaIncrease
methods.description: Requests an increase to a service quota.

methods.name: requestServiceQuotaIncreaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously requests an increase to a service quota.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
